def fit(F):

        return p[0]*np.sin(p[1]*t)*np.sqrt(v)+p[2]*np.exp(-p[3]*np.sqrt(v))+p[4]*F(p[5],p[6])-dv_dt
    bestc=None

        p0=rs.uniform(-2,2,7); p0[1]=0.6; p0[3]=1.7
        try:
            q=least_squares(r,p0,max_nfev=300)
